name: China Oilfield Services Limited
summary: China Oilfield Services Limited, together with its subsidiaries, provides integrated oilfield services in China, Indonesia, Mexico, Norway, the Middle East, and internationally. The company operates through four divisions: Geophysical Services, Drilling Services, Well Services, and Marine and Transportation Services.
